rationale.conceptual: The method uses well‑documented equations (γ_iP from ln(ν) vs ln(V) slope, γ_iT from (K0/ν)(dν/dP), a_i from δ ln ν vs T) and does not require inventing anything new. It demands understanding the formulas and integrating data from external sources, but remains a standard application in mineral physics.

Only standard libraries (numpy, scipy) are needed, and data acquisition involves extracting small tables from public references; no complex multi‑tool orchestration or environment setup.
